body.x: Seidio(www.seidio.com), the leading manufacturer of premium Smartphone accessories, will be exhibiting at the International Consumer Electronics Show from January 10-13th at the Las Vegas Convention Center. Seidio’s booth, #3818, will be located in the iLounge section of the North Hall. “We look forward to learning more about the new devices and technology that will become available.”

CES “reaches across global markets” to showcase innovation from the consumer electronics industry, making it the optimal event for Seidio to showcase new power solutions and cases for a wide variety of Smartphones.

In 2011 alone, Seidio introduced the Charging Vault and SURFACE Reveal amongst other accessories. The Charging Vault provides a new kind of convenience for mobile professionals, functioning both as a portable external power source and a wall charger. This universal accessory eliminates the need to find an outlet when you’re traveling, giving users the freedom to charge anywhere.

Seidio also extended their line of cases with the SURFACE Reveal and the ACTIVE Extended. The SURFACE Reveal for the iPhone 4/4S is a thin case with a cut-out for the Apple logo while the ACTIVE Extended, a dual layered case, protects Android devices with Seidio extended batteries installed.

“Knowing that new phones and tablets are released so quickly now, we are continually gauging the needs of consumers to develop innovative accessories that will help users increase the functionality of their devices,” said David Chang, CEO. “We look forward to learning more about the new devices and technology that will become available.”

Seidio was founded in 2002 in the bustling metropolitan city of Houston, Texas. We are a company by professionals, for professionals. We design smarter mobile accessories for today’s mobile professional, and we take our work very seriously. We provide an array of products including screen guards, extended life batteries, three levels of protective cases, charging docks, car kits and our accessories work together to provide an array of Smartphone solutions.
